title: Public Class Group Projection
objective: Publish a context-owned sealed conditional class-group semantic core transactionally and return fresh lightweight public views with independent verification and detached replay

oracles: Current independently verified IdealClassGroup adapter and byte-equivalent conditional proof payload
C4 quintic exact invariants, proof status, generator relations, explicit verify, and detached proof replay

handoff.summary: Adds a transactional context-owned canonical projection for reusable conditional public class groups. The ordinary adapter and full verification run once, then each hit returns a fresh lightweight view; ideal shells are materialized lazily and explicit verify/proof replay reconstructs the ordinary detached path. C4 repeat observation measured 10.69ms median over 1000 views with byte-equivalent proof payloads and full verification.
risks: This is intentionally only a repeat-observation slice: the prepared-context first adapter remains 5.78s and is not claimed as improved.
Only reusable proof=False general engine results participate; unconditional, callback, cancellation, checkpoint, custom, specialized, and interposed paths remain cold.
Retaining 1000 views costs about 50MB of ordinary wrapper ownership; 1000 discarded views return below the post-engine RSS baseline after explicit GC.
next_steps: Independently audit transactional publication, exact-type replacement failure, canonical mutation isolation, and explicit full replay.
Treat producer-issued first-public authority as a separate measured lane rather than broadening this repeat-view commit.
